protocol.legacy: Exact pre-model browser recipe, 75% uniformly sampled legal moves plus 25% seeded one-ply heuristic top-three; book disabled; seed (placement count+1)*7919 as in the browser
protocol.selection: Deterministic legal argmax; tiny/value evaluate only immediate successor; policy directly masks 64 logits. D4 mean. No noise, book or terminal override.
protocol.limits: 50 paired-color screening games per pairing; no Elo, significance, or human win-rate claim. Unequal search budgets are intentional. No default promotion.
